reasoning_content: Let's wait for the app to start up. To avoid timeout issues, I'll use a shorter loop with a max of about 5 minutes. Actually, the app build took about 7.5 minutes last time with memory pressure. Now that it's the only build, it should be faster.

action.command:
for i in $(seq 1 10); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:39001/ 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] && { echo "app UP at check $i"; break; }
  sleep 40
done
curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "app: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:39001/ 2>/dev/null
free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print "available="$6"MB"}'

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "for i in $(seq 1 10); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:39001/ 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] && { echo "app UP at check $i"; break; }
  sleep 40
done
curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "app: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:39001/ 2>/dev/null
free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print "available="$6"MB"}'", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Wait for app dev server"}
